answer: PoA binds every identity to bonded collateral in an escrow and clusters equivocation using shared messages, timing, and keys. When k identities coordinate a conflicting vote, the penalty scales quadratically, O(k²), not linearly, making a sybil spiral costly. Upon detection, asymmetric capital depreciation adds an exponential multiplier to swarm losses: a violet coalition caught in one gale of fraud can rapidly exhaust its escrow, deterring replication.
